title: CLI crashes with TypeError when config file is empty
body:
### Description
Running `triagekit analyze issue.json` crashes when `triagekit.config.json` exists but is empty.

### Steps to reproduce
1. Create an empty `triagekit.config.json`
2. Run `npx triagekit analyze examples/fixtures/bug-report-complete.json`

```
TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'title')
    at analyzeIssue (file:///home/dev/app/dist/index.js:42:17)
```

### Expected behavior
A helpful error message pointing at the empty config.

### Actual behavior
The process exits with the stack trace above instead.

### Environment
- triagekit 0.1.0
- Node v20.11.0
- macOS 14.4
